parsed.rationale: One of the two `MetricRow` type-alias-object records lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` in the `Wallpaper` package, which is clearly under an Examples/SampleApp path. The other lives in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift` in the `DebugPanel` package. The sample-app copy is almost certainly a local convenience alias introduced to avoid a hard dependency on the `DebugPanel` package from within the sample app, making the duplication intentional. Additionally, the structural evidence fields (jaccard, shared_field_count, differing_slots) are all null and both records carry empty `fields_or_signature` lists, so there is no substantive shared implementation to consolidate.
